rules: BeerJSON source value and unit tokens MUST be preserved independently from the native FermentationJSON representation.
A BeerJSON measurable type does not automatically define one FermentationJSON quantity kind when the source type mixes distinct scientific semantics.
Field-level mappings MAY refine a neutral type-level quantity kind when the field semantics justify a more specific kind.
No conversion relationship is implied for analytical or empirical scales until its semantics and source are documented.
BeerJSON range endpoints are independently typed quantity objects and MAY carry different units; lossless import therefore preserves endpoint-specific reported units when necessary.

AcidityType.notes: BeerJSON v1.0.2 permits only the pH token; import as exact pH without inventing reference temperature or averaging semantics.

TimeType.notes: BeerJSON restricts the source value to integer; FermentationJSON preserves that source integer even though its canonical duration model is not restricted to integers.

PercentType.notes: The generic type-level mapping is fraction. Field semantics may refine this to mass_fraction, volume_fraction, or another explicitly justified fraction kind.

SpecificHeatType.notes: J/(kg K) is mapped. BeerJSON does not define which calorie or BTU realization its other tokens mean, so those tokens remain preserved but unresolved.

ConcentrationType.notes: ppm and ppb are preserved as ratio quantities. A field/domain mapping may derive mass concentration only with explicit analyte and basis assumptions.

UnitType.notes: BeerJSON uses this type for count-like and unitless amounts. FJSON does not equate package counts, item counts, and mathematical dimensionless ratios without field/item context.

DiastaticPowerType.notes: Lintner and WK map to distinct scale-defined diastatic-power quantity kinds. Cross-scale conversion is explicit calculation work, not unit conversion.

ColorType.notes: SRM, EBC, and Lovibond map to distinct native color-index kinds/scales; no implicit cross-scale conversion is performed.

CarbonationType.notes: vols maps to a scale-defined CO2 volume ratio; g/l maps to physical mass concentration of CO2. Conversion between them requires explicit reference conditions.

BitternessType.notes: IBUs map to a scale-defined bitterness index and are not identified with iso-alpha-acid concentration or perceived bitterness.

GravityType.notes: Gravity tokens map to distinct native scale-defined quantity kinds; SG, Plato, and Brix are not unit aliases.

DateType.notes: Date/date-time lexical mapping belongs to metadata/process semantics, not the quantity model.

QualitativeRangeType.notes: Qualitative labels are categorical values, not numerical quantities.

VersionType.notes: BeerJSON version is metadata, not a quantity.
